content.title: United Q4 earnings are 'nice conclusion' to wild 2025: Analyst
content.description:
United Airlines (UAL) topped its fourth quarter earnings estimates and guidance figures, reporting adjusted earnings of $3.10 per share (vs. expectations of $2.92) and revenue of $13.93 billion (vs. expectations of $13.87 billion).

Third Bridge Global Head of Analysts Peter McNally takes a look at what United's latest earnings release represent for the airline operator after a generally rocky past year for the industry.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.

content.title: United Airlines’ 2025 Results Soar Past Expectations
content.summary: United Airlines’ fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results soared past Wall Street’s expectations.  The carrier reported fourth-quarter adjusted earnings of $3.10 a share on revenue of $15.4 billion, up 4.8% and the highest quarterly revenue in United history, beating expectations.  Revenue of $59.07 billion, up 3.5% and the highest in United’s history, was slightly above the $59.05 billion expected.
